senses.gloss:
कुवलयापीड

KUVALAYĀPĪḌA . Name of the elephant posted at the gates of Mathurāpurī to kill śrī kṛṣṇa and balabhadrarāma, who went there to witness the dhanuryajña. But, they killed the elephant.Raṅgadvāraṁ samāsādya
Tasmin nāgamavasthitam ।
Apaśyat Kuvalayāpīḍaṁ
Kṛṣṇo smbaṣṭhapracoditam ।।
(bhāgavata, Daśama skandha, Chapter 48, Verse 2).

कुवीरा

KUVĪRĀ . A river. (bhīṣma parva Chapter 27).
